title: GMPal
tagline: Paypal for crypto - sending crypto to another user via his Email ID.
description:
Currently, to transact in cryptocurrency, the sender needs to know the EOA address of another user. Remembering the address is really hard Hence there has always been a need for easier ways to represent users and transact with them. Solutions like Paypal and Paytm solve that by identifying users with their Phone numbers/VPA/Email IDs.

Our solution provides space for the mass adoption of crypto payments by making it super intuitive and easy to use.
how_its_made: The project got stalled multiple times because of code dependency issues and lack of complete examples for developing the dapps. The people at the booth were however, very helpful and helped us understand the solution to the problems we were facing.
